pitfallsHtml: Common pitfalls, contrasts with adjacent concepts, and further reading go here.

questions.rationale: Explain why B is right, and why each distractor is wrong (the misconception each one tests).

questions.prompt: Multi-select (select all that apply). Which of these are true?
questions.rationale: All-and-only the correct options are required for the point.

questions.prompt: Fill-in (single blank). Rust's core memory-safety concept is ____.
questions.rationale: Provide every equivalent phrasing in `accepted`; the scorer normalizes (trim, lowercase, collapse whitespace).

questions.prompt: Fill-in (multi-blank, order-tolerant). The two phases are ____ and ____.
questions.rationale: Multi-blank is order-tolerant: each value must be in `accepted`, no duplicates, all filled.

questions.prompt: Short-answer (self-checked key points). In your own words, why does this design fail under condition Z?
keyPoints: identifies that the failure is caused by X
names the underlying mechanism (the Y rule)
notes the trade-off the fix introduces
questions.answer: Reference answer: the design fails because of X; the underlying mechanism is Y; the standard fix is Z, which introduces the trade-off of …
questions.rationale: Score = (points you honestly self-check) / (total points). Keep the honesty framing in mind.
